_doc: Operational rules. Edit only with the operational partner's written agreement; every change is versioned in git. See docs/model-validation.md section 6.
approved_by: PENDING - to be agreed with RBC Malaria & NTD Division

high.label: High priority for verification
high.meaning: At the 90% confidence level the model's prediction set contains only 'formation'. On the test window this held for the calls counted in Replay & Validation.

moderate.label: Moderate priority for verification
moderate.meaning: Disabled until the partner agrees a threshold. With no agreed threshold no site is placed in this category.

insufficient.label: Insufficient evidence to classify
insufficient.meaning: The model cannot separate the outcomes at 90% confidence. Field verification is the only way to classify these sites.

lower.label: Lower current priority
lower.meaning: At 90% confidence the model expects no new water. This is not evidence that the site is free of larvae.

alerts.recommended_action: Assign a field inspection (dipping) before the target date. Do not treat on the basis of the forecast alone.

intervention.eligible_when: verified observation with larvae_present == yes, or water_present == yes and larvae_present == not_sampled
intervention.note: A forecast never authorises larvicide application. Authorisation follows the national protocol referenced on each record.
